我需要根据四个维度对A和B进行评分（1-3分制）：

3. 关键决策信息覆盖度

"The idea of supporting decision making by directly attending to a cache of related events has been explored in various contexts under the names of case‑based reasoning [1], non‑parametric reinforcement learning [2]–[5], and episodic memory [6, 7]. Some approaches focus on enhancing an agent’s working memory during a single episode [8, 9] or across a series of successive related episodes [10]. Other methods aim to exploit a broader class of relevant experience or persistent knowledge, including information spanning multiple episodes or originating from other agents, to improve reasoning and planning. Earlier work often prescribes how to process the retrieved information, for example by defining the agent’s action‑value directly in terms of previously generated value estimates [11]–[14] or by constructing a model from observed transitions [15]. Attention mechanisms have also been employed to select which parts of available trajectories to use, typically operating on a limited retrieval batch rather than the entire experience dataset [16]. A separate line of research leverages transition datasets through experience replay at training time, allowing multiple gradient updates per experience; this technique is common in modern reinforcement‑learning algorithms [17]–[20] but does not provide benefits at test time, requires additional learning steps to adapt to new data, and does not enable end‑!to!end learning of how past experience relates to new situations."

该文本只有一段。它总结了先前的研究。它没有提到当前论文的贡献或定位。因此，它不符合最后一段必须包含贡献和定位的要求。根据评分标准，得分为0。
